subject: Request: Exec approval for BrightLabs combined discount + credit (pilot extension)
messages:
From: Samir Kapadia <samir@brightlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and next steps

Karthik — thanks for the demo today. The team liked the latency profile and the billing detail you shared. A couple procurement asks before we can move to PO: can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a six-week pilot extension and whether you offer any promotional credits tied to usage? Also, our legal has a few redlines in the SOW — attaching the procurement questions.

Samir
BrightLabs

Attachment: BrightLabs_Procurement_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapadia <samir@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and next steps

Hi Samir — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: yes to a six-week extension (no-cost), and we can offer a one-time promotional credit against usage for the pilot while legal works through the SOW. I need exec sign-off for the combined package (extension + credits) because it exceeds our standard threshold.

Proposal I will seek approval for:
- Six-week no-cost pilot extension (extend current trial window to 12 weeks total)
- $25,000 one-time usage credit applied during the pilot period
- Standard pilot SLOs and ROI check at week 8

I want to route this for a quick exception approval from leadership to keep momentum. Laura — can you confirm whether the $25k number is acceptable or whether we should request a smaller credit with an alternate amortization? Vivek — tagging for exec approval.

Next steps: if approved, I will send a short amendment to the existing SOW and get procurement into DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and next steps

Karthik — thanks, this sounds on-brand for close-the-pilot plays. A few internal notes before we escalate:
- $25k credit on a cloud-heavy inference workload can be material; what's the expected token consumption estimate for the 6-week extension? (rough ballpark numbers help Vivek decide).
- Is BrightLabs likely to convert to Dedicated within 6 months? If theres a clear path to expansion we can be more flexible.

Suggested compromise if Vivek pushes back: $15k credit + 15% first-year discount on first Dedicated renewal. But if BrightLabs shows strong POC metrics we should be prepared to move to $25k.

Karthik, can you add the consumption estimate and reply-all so Vivek has the numbers to act on?

Laura
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samir Kapadia <samir@brightlabs.com>, procurement@brightlabs.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and next steps

Team — consumption estimate attached and summarized below. I also included Samir so procurement sees the potential commercial and timing.

Estimate (conservative) for six-week extension:
- Expected tokens (input+output): ~12M tokens
- Estimated spend @ default plan: ~$32k
- Net after $25k credit: ~$7k (customer would pay any overage beyond credit)

Commercial rationale: this pilot is compute-heavy but the credit materially reduces friction; BrightLabs is targeting a Dedicated decision by Q1 (they have internal infra consolidation coming). They are motivated to move quickly if we can keep their first-month budget scoped.

Proposed ask for exec approval:
- Approve six-week no-cost extension + $25,000 promotional usage credit to be applied pro-rata during the extension.
- Approval contingent on: BrightLabs signs amendment and procurement confirms acceptance of standard pilot terms.

Attachments: BrightLabs_PoV_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)

Karthik
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samir Kapadia <samir@brightlabs.com>, procurement@brightlabs.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and next steps

Approved.

I reviewed the consumption estimate and the go-to-market rationale. Approve the exception as follows:
- Six-week pilot extension (no change to SLOs).
- One-time $25,000 usage credit to be applied during the extended pilot window.
- Requirement: credit expires at the end of the pilot extension and cannot be applied to post-pilot Dedicated invoices.
- Require a short amendment in DocuSign that references the credit and the expiration; legal to route standard amendment language.

Karthik — proceed to send the amendment and confirm DocuSign envelope. Marissa, please prepare a short internal note for Finance to track the credit against DL-2026-0881. Laura — keep close on the conversion cadence; if BrightLabs commits to Dedicated renewal within 90 days we will consider additional commercial incentives.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
